quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsui Mining & Smelting press release: Mitsui Kinzoku Signs Joint Development Agreement with (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mitsui Kinzoku entered into a joint development agreement with Factorial Energy (headquartered in Massachusetts, U.S.) toward the commercialization of all-solid-state batteries (ASSBs). The agreement aims to advance battery cell manufacturing processes using Mitsui Kinzoku's sulfide solid electrolyte material A-SOLiD(TM): the partners will enhance solid electrolyte performance using A-SOLiD, develop layer formation technologies and verify suitability for mass production. Factorial remains the fabless cell innovator, leading cell design, process development, supply chain qualification, line integration and manufacturing validation. The release calls Factorial a global leader in solid-state battery technology (company description). No dollar figures, volumes or timelines stated.
